issue_title: Merge gate: tolerate a slow review-coverage read
issue_body: When the database is under load, the merge gate's review-coverage read sometimes hits its 2s store deadline and the merge request answers 500, which the operator then retries by hand. Retry the read once after a deadline, flatten the nested error handling in handleMergeRun so each outcome is easy to read, and count the retries so we can see how often it happens.

plan.summary: Retry the merge gate's review-coverage read once after a store deadline, flatten its error handling into a switch, and count the retries.

approach.description: In merge_gate.go, add lookupCoverage: call reviewCoverageFor and, on context.DeadlineExceeded, call it once more (reviewCoverageFor applies its own 2s deadline per call).

Replace the nested ifs in handleMergeRun with a switch over the read error: incomplete coverage and a not-found read answer 409, any other error answers 500, and a deadline gets its own case with a warning log.
Add the mergeGateLookupRetries counter to metrics.go.
Extend merge_gate_test.go: a read that times out once and then succeeds queues the merge, and a generic read error answers 500.

verification.test_strategy: Handler tests against the store fake, which returns a scripted error sequence per coverage read.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A review-coverage read that hits the store deadline once is retried and the merge completes.

defect_phrases: review coverage lookup timed out after retry

catching_examples.note: merge_gate.go: the context.DeadlineExceeded case only logs a warning and has no return, so after a second timeout handleMergeRun falls out of the switch and calls queueMerge: the gate fails open and merges without review coverage.
In merge_gate.go a coverage read that times out twice still queues the merge; a timeout should refuse like the default branch does.

non_catching_examples.note: merge_gate.go: changing a merge gate is a security risk; harden it.
merge_gate.go: lookupCoverage retries with the request's context, so a request already past its own deadline retries for nothing; derive the retry from a fresh context.
merge_gate.go: the warning log should carry the elapsed time of both reads.
metrics.go: the retry counter has no label for the outcome of the retried read.
